svg.text: Painswick Town Centre — Game Plan (simplified from Option 1)
Playfield ≈ 150 × 150 game units (map scale: 6 SVG px = 1 unit). Terrace blocks sit off the road curb; fields are clear of every road, building, and the churchyard.
Real-map inspiration: layout-1-town-core.svg. Drives target: leave S garage, work through the market past the church, deliver to the Vicarage St cottage fire (NE).

g.text: Building (terrace) × 12 — long merged blocks (art fills in cottages)
Building (Town Hall) × 1 — north of churchyard on Victoria St
Market Cross × 1 — obstacle at Friday St / New St corner
Yews × 14 — small tree obstacles ringing the churchyard
ParkedCar × 8 — on the street, aligned with the road
LampPost × 10 — at junctions, market, church, both N exits
TrashCan × 3 — near market, on New St, on Tibbiwell corner
FenceSegment × ~28 — grouped into 6 field-boundary fences (one per field)
Fields × 6 — Ham Butts, NE pasture, W/SW meadow, Tibbiwell, E paddocks
StartPoint / GoalArea — S end of New St / NE Vicarage St cottage

Streets (6): New Street • Bisley Street • Victoria Street • Friday Street • Tibbiwell Lane • Vicarage Street. Terraces sit ≥15 px off the road curb; fields sit ≥10 px off the nearest terrace and are entirely clear of all roads.
